cases.situation: My mother-in-law said 'must be nice to order takeout every night' while visiting. It's a one-off dig and I don't want a thing.
cases.reply: Ha, it's been a hectic month! Actually, would you show me your chicken soup next time you're over? Luca still talks about it.
cases.note: Face value denies the dig any oxygen, and the question is genuine, not flattery.

cases.situation: 室友在群里说“我就自己倒垃圾吧，反正也没人管”。确实最近几次都是她倒的。
cases.reply: 听起来你是烦我最近没倒垃圾，这确实是我的问题。我现在就去倒。以后我们排个表，一人一周，你看行吗？
cases.note: 她的不满有道理时，处理内容，不纠结语气。

cases.situation: Since I got engaged, my best friend keeps making little digs ('some of us still pay rent alone'). I asked once and she said she's fine. It just happened again.
cases.reply: This is the second time I've asked and got a sharp reply, so I'm not going to keep guessing. If something about the engagement is hard for you, I'd honestly rather hear it straight. Whenever you want to talk, I'm here, and until then I'll take things at face value.
cases.note: Second time, name the pattern and hand her the choice. Then really do take messages at face value.

cases.situation: 部门工作群里，同事老周发了一句“有些人的周报还是没交啊，大家都等着汇总呢”，明显是说我。确实晚了一天，因为在等财务那边的数据。
cases.reply: 是我这份，财务的数据昨天下午才给到，我今天中午12点前发到群里。晚了一天，耽误大家汇总了，不好意思。
cases.note: The dig has a real complaint inside it, so answer the contents with a time; do not comment on his tone in front of the group.

cases.situation: My sister texted 'Don't worry, I'll host Thanksgiving AGAIN, it's fine, someone has to.' She's hosted three years running and I did say I'd take a turn. I'd rather not do this over text.
cases.reply: That sounds like it's not fine, and fair enough: you've hosted three years in a row and I said I'd take a turn. Can I call you tonight after 8? I'd like to sort out this year properly, and I'm happy for it to be at mine.
cases.note: The dig wraps a legitimate point, so own it and move to a call; over text this one turns into a fight.

cases.situation: Freelance designer. Client Mark emailed 'As I've already said twice, the logo needs to be bigger. Not sure how else to put it.' I did make it bigger in v2 and he approved v2 on Friday. Now we're on v3.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, understood, you'd like the logo bigger than it is in v3. So I get it right this round: should it fill about a third of the header width, or closer to half? I'll send the revised version by 3pm tomorrow, Wednesday.
cases.note: Answer the request, not the tone, and turn a vague 'bigger' into a choice so there is no v4. Raise the v2 approval only if extra rounds become a billing question.

cases.situation: I joined standup 5 minutes late this morning because a customer call ran over. Right after, my manager Colleen posted in the team channel: 'Friendly reminder that standup starts at 9:30, for those who forgot.' Obviously aimed at me. First time I've been late in months.
cases.reply: Hi Colleen, that one was me, sorry for joining late this morning. A call with Brightwater ran over and I should have given you a heads-up. If it ever happens again, I'll message you before 9:30.
cases.note: Reply privately, not in the channel. A small, fair complaint sits inside the dig, so own it in one line and deal with the contents; no comment on the tone.

cases.situation: 我妈在家族群里发：“现在都是大忙人了，一个月也想不起来给妈打个电话。” 明显是说我，确实最近加班很少打电话。不想在群里接这个话。
cases.reply: 妈，最近确实打得少了，是我不好。今晚八点我给您打视频，好好聊聊，让朵朵给您看看她新学的舞。
cases.note: 私聊回，不在群里接；她的不满有道理，就认一句，再换成更亲近的方式联系，不解释加班。

cases.situation: Rob in finance emailed me: 'Per my last email, I still need the Q3 vendor invoices. Not sure how else to ask.' I checked, and he did email me on Sept 21 and I missed it.
cases.reply: Hi Rob, thanks for resending, I'd missed your email on the 21st, that's on me. All 14 Q3 vendor invoices are attached, plus the two credit notes from Halden. Let me know if anything's still missing.
cases.note: Take it at face value: own the miss in half a sentence, give him what he needs, and leave the tone alone.

cases.situation: We had friends over Saturday and it ran late. This morning there's a note on our door from the downstairs neighbour: 'Hope the party was fun! Some of us have to work in the morning :)' I've never met her properly. I want to reply without starting a feud.
cases.reply: Hi, it's Dan from 3B. Got your note, and you're right, we ran late on Saturday. Sorry about that. Next time we have people over I'll let you know in advance and we'll wrap up by 11. If it's ever too loud, just knock or text me on 07700 900312.
cases.note: The snark wraps a fair complaint, so answer the contents, own it once, and give her a direct channel so the next one isn't a note.

cases.situation: I'm a team lead. At 3pm on Friday I asked my report Jamal to update the client deck for Monday at 10, because the client had just moved the meeting up. He replied in Slack: 'Sure, I'll just cancel my weekend then 🙂'. Honestly, it is a lot to drop on him.
cases.reply: Sounds like that landed badly, and that's fair, it's a lot to drop on you at 3 on a Friday. Your weekend stays yours. Could you update just the pricing slide before you log off today? I'll do the rest myself first thing Monday.
cases.note: When the snark wraps a legitimate grievance, name it, concede the fair part and change the ask; don't answer the tone.

cases.situation: 下周我要去成都出差四天，跟老婆说了以后，她回了一句：“去吧去吧，反正家里两个孩子我一个人弄惯了。”这个月我确实已经出差三次了。
cases.reply: 听起来你是真累了。这个月我出差三次，家里的事都压在你一个人身上，这不公平。回来那个周末两个孩子我全包，你好好歇两天。今晚孩子睡了我们聊聊，看以后出差怎么安排，才不会总是你一个人扛，好吗？
cases.note: 抱怨里有真实内容时，先接住内容，给一个具体补偿，再约时间谈根本的安排。
